description:
[BUG] Stacks not removed on Library deletion

**Problem Description**
When deleting an External Library, a Stack that contains photos from this External Library will not be unstacked.
The Stack stays with the cover photo in the library. 
Manual unstacking is needed, so that the stack will be removed from the Timeline.

**Expected Behavior**
If a Stack contains _only_ photos from one External Library AND this External Library will be deleted, also unstack/delete the stack.
If a Stack contains photos from various External Library but only one External Library will be deleted, keep the stack with remaining photos

tests_added: asset.service.spec.ts: should delete the stack when a non-primary asset is deleted and only the primary would remain
asset.service.spec.ts: should keep the stack when a non-primary asset is deleted and the primary plus another asset remain

notes: Issue symptom (stack lingers after library deletion). Fix rewrites stack handling in AssetService.handleAssetDeletion (delete stack if <2 remain, promote primary otherwise); RC exact. Boundary "job" correct: LibraryService.handleDeleteLibrary queues JobName.AssetDelete (library.service.ts:394) -> asset.service.ts:301 @OnJob.
